verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party Structured Outputs docs say responses conform to a supplied JSON Schema, and that `strict: true` uses constrained decoding to guarantee the output matches the schema exactly. That directly delivers reliable parsing. Missing for 10: documentation of which models support strict mode and any schema-feature limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of schema enforcement.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably

citations.quote: With strict: true, the model uses constrained decoding to guarantee that the output will always match your schema exactly.
Structured Outputs is a feature that ensures your model responses conform to your provided JSON Schema
Guarantee model responses strictly conform to your JSON schema for reliable, type-safe data structures.
